literal: Что должно пересечь линию ворот для правильного их прохождения в горных лыжах, если обе лыжи сохранены, по правилам FIS 2026 года?

fields.individualAnalysis: Correct gate passage requires both ski tips and both feet crossing the gate line.

proofBindings.title: fis-icr-2026.pdf
proofBindings.exactQuote:

remaining ski and both feet must have crossed the gate line.  
661.4.1

literal: Какую задачу IIHF приписывает ловящей перчатке вратаря?
fields.individualAnalysis: The blocker is worn on the hand holding the stick and blocks shots on that side.

proofBindings.title: iihf-olympic-2026-terminology.html
proofBindings.exactQuote: Goalkeeper equipment worn on the hand holding the stick, used to block shots on that side.

fields.literal: Блин надевают на руку с клюшкой, чтобы блокировать броски с этой стороны.
fields.individualAnalysis: Face mask protects the face; it is a different IIHF term.

proofBindings.title: iihf-olympic-2026-terminology.html
proofBindings.exactQuote: Protective mask worn by the goalkeeper in Men's or Women's play or by players in the Women's competition.

fields.literal: Маска защищает лицо; её описывает отдельный термин IIHF.
fields.individualAnalysis: Catcher/trapper is on the hand without the stick and catches or stops shots.

proofBindings.title: iihf-olympic-2026-terminology.html
proofBindings.exactQuote: Special goalkeeper's glove worn on the non-stick hand, which is intended to catch or stop shots.

fields.literal: Ловушка находится на руке без клюшки и предназначена для ловли или остановки бросков.
fields.individualAnalysis: Goalkeeper stick is used primarily to defend the goal; the glove itself catches/blocks.

proofBindings.title: iihf-olympic-2026-terminology.html
proofBindings.exactQuote: Held by skaters and used to pass or carry the puck. The stick has a straight shaft held by the players and a curved blade for carrying, passing, or shooting the puck. The blade is made up of a heel (area closest to the shaft) and a toe (area furthest from the shaft). A goalkeeper’s stick has a wider blade and shaft and is used primarily for defending the goal.

fields.literal: Клюшка вратаря предназначена прежде всего для защиты ворот; блин на руке помогает отбить бросок.
fields.individualAnalysis: IIHF says the trapping glove catches or stops shots.

proofBindings.title: iihf-olympic-2026-terminology.html
proofBindings.exactQuote: Special goalkeeper's glove worn on the non-stick hand, which is intended to catch or stop shots.

fields.literal: Ловушка надевается на руку, свободную от клюшки, и служит для ловли или остановки бросков. Блин на другой руке блокирует их со стороны клюшки.
fields.individualAnalysis: The two gloves have different jobs: the catcher catches/stops, blocker blocks on the stick side.

proofBindings.title: iihf-olympic-2026-terminology.html
proofBindings.exactQuote: Special goalkeeper's glove worn on the non-stick hand, which is intended to catch or stop shots.
